d: Former Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, currently living in exile in India, has sought to return to Dhaka on December 16, Bangladesh's Victory Day. But the Tarique Rahman-led government has warned that she will be arrested the moment she enters the country. With Dhaka demanding her extradition from India, Awami League supporters taking to the streets, and bomb blasts and arson attacks reported across 28 districts, Bangladesh faces fresh political uncertainty. What does Hasina's possible return mean for Bangladesh and India's position in the standoff?
